name: Registration closing study: pair-calibrated VCS structure matcher (inference-only A/B/C)
features: frozen RoMa encoder at 560: DINOv2 stride-14 (1024) bilinear-upsampled to the VGG stride-4 grid (140x140) + VGG scale-4 (256), each L2-normalised, concat/sqrt2; per-modality PCA + k-means simplex basis fit once on FIT descriptors (no gradient training)

basis.temperature: median squared distance to the nearest centre on FIT, per modality

fit.note: FIT 32 cores x perturbations 0,1: basis + global W (C4) from real host seeds

critic: M1 simplex-bilinear f = a^T W b, W in [-1,1]^(32x32) (|f|<=1), v10.mf_vcs QuadraticHead/solve_box_head, V-mode product (complete marginal product, diagonal included), uniform support weights, float64

vcs.rule: FW-gap tolerance = rel_tol x G(0) (M1 relative rule)

bce.objective: 0.5 E_P log((1+f)/2) + 0.5 E_Q log((1-f)/2), same P/Q and class, box shrunk by eps

settings.C6a: L-BFGS-B capped at the VCS solve's iteration count for the pair
settings.C6b: L-BFGS-B to box gap <= rel_tol x gap(0) or max_iter (convergence reported)

blocks.layout: 4x4 blocks on reference coordinates; support blocks (bi+bj) even, check blocks odd

support.rule: host matches at the host-selected angle that are host-RANSAC inliers (tau 3), bidirectionally consistent (B->A RoMa warp within bidir_px of the source), RoMa certainty >= cert_min, inside support blocks outside the guard band; at most per_block per block by certainty, at most max_total

queries.region: grid points in check blocks outside the guard band

window.meaning: target search disk in the rotated moving image covering |t|<=51x1.05 and residual rotation <=10 deg

queries.peak: top-1 on the 140x140 target grid + parabolic sub-cell refinement; 2nd peak >= peak2_sep_px away recorded for top-2 coverage only

ransac.seeds: ctx seed*1009 + host angle index (+1 new-only, +2 seed-only, +3 seed+new)

arms.C2_extra_search: host matches + RoMa's own dense-warp target at the SAME query positions (equal extra budget)
arms.C3_seed_only: RANSAC on the support set only
arms.C4_global_vcs: fixed global VCS W fit once on FIT real seeds (multi-scene V mode), same expansion
arms.C5_pair_vcs: pair-calibrated VCS W on this pair's support, same expansion
arms.C6a_pair_bce_samecompute: pair-calibrated balanced BCE, same iterations as C5
arms.main_point_set: host matches U new matches (as C2); secondary: support U new (seed_plus_new), new only

fallback: support < min_total or < min_blocks occupied support blocks -> C3..C6 take the host output (counted); C5 VCS solver not converged -> host output (counted)
A: CAL only (oracle support = true correspondences at support-block grid points, sweep angle nearest the true rotation; diagnostic, never deployable); real-seed calibration at the same angle reported alongside
B: DEV (and CAL): support count/error rate (truth, diagnostic)/blocks/hull/eff. rank/condition/J fit vs held-out check-block host matches/solver/fallback
C: DEV 320 (and CAL 80): six arms, strict<9/loose<42/p95/worst core/fallback; paired C5-Ck core-cluster bootstrap (B=10000) on strict
no_thresholds: no result gate; all of A, B, C run
test: never read; host DataGuard refuses TEST cores; no closed/ or quarantined Learn2Reg file is opened
revisions: pre-GPU: jsonable() also converts numpy bool (CPU check 1067821 crashed writing its report); no setting changed

pre-GPU: BCE solver changed from plain projected gradient (did not reach its gap tolerance in 5000 steps on the CPU toy, 1067822) to box L-BFGS-B so the BCE control is properly optimised; smoke output dir added
pre-full-run: cmd_fit creates the work dir (smoke 1067824 failed saving smoke/BASIS.npz after the host ran 2 FIT problems); no setting changed
smoke: R27_SMOKE=1 writes BASIS/W_GLOBAL/FIT/rows under smoke/ (fit --limit 2, run --role CAL --limit 2)
